item.description:
Amazon Play Yard Recall: What Parents Must Do Now

The play yard arrived on a Tuesday, two days before the road trip. You sliced the packing tape with a butter knife, slid the box across the hardwood like a sled, and set the folded frame upright in the living room. Plastic joints clicked. The mesh sides stretched tight, bright and new. Somewhere in the kitchen a kettle rattled, and the dog nosed the cardboard, sniffing the smell of fresh fabric and factory glue.

item.title: Powerful earthquake strikes off the coast of Japan — sustainable luggage scale
item.description:
Japan Quake Lessons & Eco-Friendly Luggage Scales

It begins as a murmur beneath your feet. Just enough to make chopsticks rattle in their paper sleeve. The vending machines hum. The neon sign across the street shivers. In a quiet business hotel near the northern coast, hallway doors tremble like someone’s leaning on each one. Then the phones erupt. That metallic siren, the high-pitched chirp that slices the morning. People step out in socks, eyes wide, trying to gauge the wobble of a building they trusted ten minutes ago.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Oct. 26) — sustainable luggage scale
item.description:
Greener Trips: Choosing a Sustainable Luggage Scale

The airport floor felt cold through my sneakers as the line zigzagged under harsh lights. You could hear the frantic reshuffling—zippers stuttering, toiletries tossed from one bag to another, a stranger pleading with a gate agent. It was the ritual every traveler dreads: the last-minute weigh-in. My duffel teetered on the airline scale, and I caught the number just before it blinked out. Fifty-point-six pounds. The agent gave me that sympathetic wince that says, “I’ve seen a thousand like you today.”

item.title: Apple ends support for Clips video-editing app — sustainable luggage scale
item.description:
Apple Clips Ends: Travel Video Options + Gear Tips

The moment Apple sunsets an app, travelers feel it on the road. Clips—the playful, social-first video editor Apple launched in 2017—has officially reached the end of the line. For mobile creators who relied on Clips for quick cuts, captions, and shareable styles, that news stings. But it also opens the door to building a leaner, longer-lasting travel workflow—and rethinking the gear you pack, down to a sustainable luggage scale that keeps your bag (and your footprint) lighter.
